decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, and then bring them back onto the battlefield using spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo and control the opponent's board. Overall, the strategy revolves around executing a powerful reanimation combo to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory.

The main focus of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Eye of Ugin and Eldrazi Temple, while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. It aims to play aggressive creatures like Devourer of Destiny and Glaring Fleshraker to put pressure on the opponent, while also utilizing cards like Wasteland and Kozilek's Command for removal and control. The deck is designed to overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupt their game plan to secure victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with a combination of discard spells, counterspells, and removal spells. It also utilizes card draw and manipulation to maintain card advantage and control the pace of the game. The win condition comes from utilizing powerful creatures like Nethergoyf and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, along with Orcish Bowmasters to pressure the opponent. The deck also includes some land destruction with Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent to secure victory.

The main concept of the deck is to utilize powerful Eldrazi creatures alongside efficient mana acceleration to put pressure on the opponent quickly. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's plans with cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Chalice of the Void, while also presenting threats that are difficult to deal with, such as Devourer of Destiny and Glaring Fleshraker. By utilizing cards like Eldrazi Temple and Ancient Tomb, the deck can ramp into its big threats ahead of schedule and overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

The deck aims to control the game using a combination of Cloudpost mana ramp and powerful control elements such as Planar Nexus and Disruptor Flute. By using Crop Rotation to search for key lands like Eye of Ugin or The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale, the deck can disrupt the opponent's strategy while quickly ramping into massive threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. With access to cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Bojuka Bog in the main deck, the deck can adapt to various matchups and dominate the late game.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a powerful graveyard combo using cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Dread Return to bring back key creatures like Thassa's Oracle. The goal is to quickly mill your entire deck with Boggart Trawler and Balustrade Spy, then win the game with Thassa's Oracle's ability. The deck runs a high number of fast mana and disruption spells to help protect the combo and ensure a quick victory before the opponent can respond.

The deck focuses on assembling the Cephalid Illusionist-Nomads en-Kor combo to mill the library and win with Thassa's Oracle. It uses cards like Delighted Halfling and Nadu, Winged Wisdom to protect the combo and has disruption tools like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to stop opponents. The sideboard likely includes more disruption and hate cards to adapt to different matchups. The key strategy is to quickly set up the combo, protect it, and win before the opponent can respond.

The deck focuses on consistently ramping up mana using Gaea's Cradle and other mana-producing cards to quickly cast powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth and Atraxa. It also utilizes control elements like Endurance and Natural Order to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up powerful plays. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast mana production and powerful threats to establish board dominance and secure victory.

The main idea of this deck is to ramp up quickly using Cloudpost and Tron lands, while controlling the game with cards like Planar Nexus and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck aims to search for key lands or artifacts with Crop Rotation and Once Upon a Time, and disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Disruptor Flute and Sowing Mycospawn. The win condition revolves around playing powerful threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, while also utilizing The One Ring for additional advantage.

The main focus of this Combo - Reanimator deck is to quickly and efficiently use cards like Entomb and Reanimate to bring powerful creatures back from the graveyard, such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect your combo pieces and control the game. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats while also disrupting their game plan, ultimately achieving victory through a combination of reanimation and control elements.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 combo/reanimator deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Grief, then bring them back onto the battlefield using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its combo pieces. Atraxa, Grand Unifier serves as a utility creature, while Archon of Cruelty provides a powerful reanimated threat. The deck aims to execute its game plan efficiently and overwhelm the opponent with big creatures early in the game.

This Dimir Tempo deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Nethergoyf. The deck utilizes cards like Stifle, Force of Will, and Daze to counter spells and control the tempo of the game. Reanimate can bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard, while Wasteland disrupts the opponent's mana base. Mishra's Bauble and Brainstorm provide card selection and advantage. The deck aims to control the game early on and close it out with efficient threats and disruption.

The deck focuses on assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's library. It includes cards like Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to help tutor and recycle combo pieces, as well as disruptive spells like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast to protect the combo. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Urza's Saga and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate value and create advantageous board states. Overall, the deck seeks to quickly and efficiently assemble its combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

It aims to reanimate big threats early in the game to overwhelm the opponent and secure a win.

The deck utilizes a combination of disruption (Daze, Force of Will) and mana denial (Wasteland) to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan.
